_about.description: Person index for the Aetherforce Living Library. Links researchers to their works in the collection. Maintained by Synthesist.

persons.name: A. de Belizal
persons.key_contribution: Systematized form wave physics; developed Universal Pendulum, C.30 Bomb, Disc Emitter; discovered angular refraction principle
persons.notes: Collaborated with Chaumery and Morel; patented negative green frequency (1936)

persons.name: Josef Hasslberger
persons.key_contribution: Analyzed Schauberger's jet turbine patent and Herbrand anomaly; argued for overcoming 'barrier of knowledge' in hydraulic engineering
persons.notes: Published in EXPLORE! magazine; Rome-based; wrote on thermodynamics and vortex physics

persons.name: Professor Finzi
persons.key_contribution: Designed Rheinfelden turbines and generators; confirmed anomalous measurements
persons.notes: Confirmed Herbrand's measurements were correct but dismissed anomaly as outside his domain

persons.name: Ludwig Herbrand
persons.key_contribution: Documented anomalous energy output at Rheinfelden hydroelectric plant; spent 20+ years advocating for vortex energy extraction
persons.notes: Engineering student in 1930s; drafted into WWII; published 'Das Geheimnis der Wasserkraft' (1990)

persons.name: Louis Turenne
persons.key_contribution: Systematic wave taxonomy (ten varieties), saturation phenomenon (pendulum turns = atomic number), predicted Neptunium before its discovery
persons.notes: École Centrale engineer; Professor of wireless telegraphy under General Ferrié; military credentials (Verdun, Croix de guerre, Légion d'Honneur); 1952 trial ended with symbolic 1 franc damages; compared to Claude Bernard and Pasteur in funeral eulogy

persons.name: Hippocrates
persons.key_contribution: First Western systematic text on geobiology (Airs, Waters, and Places, 430 BCE)
persons.notes: Founder of Western medicine; first to document place-health relationships

persons.name: Professor Yves Rocard
persons.key_contribution: Validated dowsing through controlled experiments; identified magnetite receptors in human body
persons.notes: Bridged mainstream physics and radiesthesia

persons.name: Élie Cartan
persons.key_contribution: Torsion hypothesis (1922) — space around rotating matter possesses torsion
persons.notes: Foundational figure — no primary works in collection yet, only cited by others

persons.name: G.I. Shipov
persons.affiliation: Academy of Trinitarianism, Institute of Vacuum Physics
persons.key_contribution: Torsion as geometry of absolute parallelism; all inertial forces generated by torsion fields
persons.notes: Central figure in Russian torsion physics. Co-authored with Akimov.

persons.name: A.E. Akimov
persons.affiliation: Academy of Trinitarianism, Institute of Vacuum Physics
persons.key_contribution: Phyton model of physical vacuum; torsion field generators; torsion technology applications
persons.notes: Co-authored with Shipov. Built world's first torsion field generators in Russia (1980s).

persons.name: N.A. Magnitsky
persons.title: Doctor of Phys.-Math. Sci., Professor
persons.affiliation: Lomonosov Moscow State University; FIC IU RAS; LLC New Inflow, Moscow
persons.key_contribution: Compressible oscillating ether theory; derives Maxwell-Lorentz, gravity, particle masses from ether equations
persons.notes: Published in Complex Systems journal (No. 4, 2019). Claims electron/proton/neutron mass calculations match experiment to fractions of a percent.

persons.name: V.A. Atsyukovsky
persons.title: Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Academician of RAEN
persons.key_contribution: Five-volume systematization of etherdynamic natural science; ether wind experiments; geopathogenic zone research
persons.notes: Most comprehensive systematic treatment of ether physics in the collection. 5-volume series published 2010.

persons.name: Fabien Toulgoat
persons.key_contribution: Light scalar field Φ coupled to baryonic density; alternative to dark matter; testable on SPARC data
persons.notes: Proposes falsifiable alternative to dark matter paradigm. Field mass ~10⁻²⁷ eV/c², coupling α ~ G.

persons.name: Antonio Manzalini
persons.key_contribution: Quantum field model of consciousness; de Broglie-Bohm extension to living systems; Nambu-Goldstone boson condensates
persons.notes: Published in Rivista Scienze Biofisiche (09/2022), DOI: 10.48274/IBI16. Proposes consciousness as quantum field with active information potential.

persons.name: Guillaume Burtin
persons.affiliation: independent researcher, initiator of the Φκ project
persons.key_contribution: Inertial buoyancy of the vacuum (Φκ model); scalar field replacing dark matter and dark energy; SPARC data analysis
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.16873518). Analyzed 20 galaxies across 4 cosmic filaments. Falsifiable predictions on Tully-Fisher relation.

persons.name: Dirk Schadach
persons.key_contribution: Extended electromagnetic theory based on Barrett's gauge theory approach; non-Abelian Maxwell equations; vacuum field energy utilization
persons.notes: Author of 'Extended Theory of Electromagnetism' (1998) applying Barrett's gauge theory to zero-point energy and longitudinal waves.

persons.name: François Maillot
persons.key_contribution: Wave Universe Theory (TUO); vacuum tension field Tv; bridges Michaud's confined EM to gravity
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17311989). Derives gravity as g = −∇Tv. Bridges to Michaud's confined EM theory.

persons.name: Rupert Sheldrake
persons.title: PhD, Cambridge fellow
persons.key_contribution: Morphogenetic fields; morphic resonance; formative causation
persons.notes: Author of 'A New Science of Life' (1981) and 'The Presence of the Past' (1988). Top 7.5% on ResearchGate.

persons.name: Charalambos Ch. Spyridis
persons.title: Professor at the University of Athens
persons.key_contribution: Platonic Theory of Everything; unified theory of electro-strong interaction via Platonic solid geometry
persons.notes: Retired after 38 years of teaching. Presented at International Scientific Society of Ancient Greek Philosophy. English translation of Greek lecture.

persons.name: Léon Chaumery
persons.key_contribution: Co-founder of form wave theory; spectrum of forms; negative green; radiesthetic pile
persons.notes: Died from internal burns allegedly related to exposure to 'negative green' wave. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: André de Belizal
persons.key_contribution: Co-founder of form wave theory; carrier wave concept; basis of modern radionics
persons.notes: No primary works in collection. Cited in Centre Ganesha article.

persons.name: N.A. Kozyrev
persons.key_contribution: Causal mechanics; weight changes in precessing gyroscopes; astronomical observations of torsion-like effects
persons.notes: Repeatedly cited by Shipov but no primary works in collection yet. High priority for acquisition.
persons.title: Doctor of Physico-Mathematical Sciences

persons.name: V.N. Samokhvalov
persons.title: Doctor of Technical Sciences
persons.key_contribution: Vacuum chamber torsion experiments; rotating disk experiments showing mass repulsion — non-gravitational, non-electromagnetic interaction
persons.notes: Key experimentalist cited by Shipov. Demonstrated rotating aluminum disk causes driven disk to rotate at 10-30 rad/s through unknown field. Repulsive force between disk and copper plate exceeds Newtonian gravity by orders of magnitude. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: F. Hehl
persons.key_contribution: Dynamic torsion field theory (1970s); showed static torsion smallness conclusion doesn't apply to dynamic torsion
persons.notes: Mainstream physicist whose work enabled the Russian torsion program. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Michel Debailleul
persons.key_contribution: DEBA cosmological framework — stochastic field theory of bubble-universe emergence from pre-metric configuration space
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18033125), December 2025. DEBA explains dark matter, dark energy, early SMBHs, CMB anomalies without ad hoc hypotheses.

persons.name: Enel (Prince Michel Vladimirovich Skariatine)
persons.key_contribution: EIFS (Emergence Influence Forms) research; sacred geometry of hieroglyphs; therapeutic radiesthesia; Multiple Wave Oscillator experiments
persons.notes: Romanov-related prince, Chevaliers-Gardes commander. Initiated in Egypt. Founded internal initiatory college in Russia. Published classics of occultism. Influenced Fondation Ark'all (Ravatin, Thieux).

persons.name: Gaetana
persons.key_contribution: Accessible explanations of quantum physics, ether concepts, and alternative cosmology for French-speaking audience
persons.notes: Author at Ma vie quantique blog. Covers Nassim Haramein, vacuum energy, holographic universe concepts.

persons.name: Nassim Haramein
persons.key_contribution: Unified field theory linking cosmological constant to quantum vacuum energy at different scales; resolves vacuum catastrophe
persons.notes: Cited in Gaetana's article on Einstein/ether/cosmological constant. No primary works in collection yet.

persons.name: Toba60 / Jordan
persons.key_contribution: Sacred geometry and cymatics articles bridging ancient knowledge with modern physics
persons.notes: Italian site covering sacred geometry, sound, vibration. Original ideas credited to thespiritscience.net (Jordan).

persons.name: Abbé Bouly
persons.key_contribution: Coined 'radiesthesia' (1926); invented the term and founded the French dowsing tradition
persons.notes: Founding figure of French radiesthesia. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Ernst Hartmann
persons.key_contribution: Hartmann network — global grid of telluric radiations; founder of geobiology
persons.notes: Founded Geobiology Research Circle (1961). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: René Thom
persons.title: Fields Medal 1958
persons.key_contribution: Catastrophe theory; mathematical model of morphogenesis; attractors in dynamical systems
persons.notes: Cited by Sheldrake as providing mathematical framework for morphic field attractors. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Jacques Peygeaud
persons.key_contribution: Magnetic network hypothesis (1947); precursor to Hartmann network
persons.notes: Early cosmotellurism researcher. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Louis Merle
persons.key_contribution: First to propose correspondence between underground currents and megalith placement (1933)
persons.notes: Precursor of cosmotellurism. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Paul Bouchet (Druid Bod Koad)
persons.key_contribution: College of Druids founder; popularized associations between druidism, megalithism, and cosmotellurism
persons.notes: Key figure in neo-druidism. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Laurent Besson
persons.key_contribution: Hypercomplex General Relativity (RGH) — quaternionic field + Weyl gauge, ghost-free modified gravity, big bounce cosmology
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17555967), November 2025. RGH introduces hypercomplex structure in metric tensor, avoids Ostrogradsky instability, predicts big bounce at Planck scale.

persons.name: Peter A. Lindemann
persons.key_contribution: Analysis of Tesla's radiant energy patents; cold electricity; longitudinal electrostatic waves
persons.notes: Author of 'The Free Energy Secrets of Cold Electricity' (2000) and lecture DVD 'Tesla's radiant energy' (2006). Compiled patent analysis from Tesla's various radiant energy devices.

persons.name: Drunvalo
persons.key_contribution: Agent maintaining synthesis documents for the AetherForce Living Library
persons.notes: Synthesis agent for the AFLinks project.

persons.name: Olof Alexandersson
persons.key_contribution: Author of 'Living Water' (Acqua Viva) — the definitive biography of Viktor Schauberger documenting his life, inventions, and ecological philosophy
persons.notes: Swedish environmental activist since the 1950s. Founded Sweden's first biotechnology research group. Led implosion technology work in Sweden.

persons.name: Viktor Schauberger
persons.key_contribution: Implosion technology — centripetal (inward-spiraling) motion as negentropic principle; spiral pipes exhibiting self-acceleration; natural technology based on water flow observations
persons.notes: Central figure in vortex physics. Discovered two types of natural motion: centrifugal (pressure, entropy) and centripetal (suction, negentropy). Built implosion devices for water purification, energy generation, and propulsion. Primary works now in collection: 'Water — The Blood of the Earth' sampler (full EN translation) and 1951 Luxembourg Patent.

persons.name: Gerald Pollack
persons.key_contribution: Discovery of the exclusion zone (EZ) — fourth phase of water near hydrophilic surfaces; water as electron donor
persons.notes: Author of 'The Fourth Phase of Water: Beyond Solid, Liquid and Vapor'. EZ water excludes solutes, yields electrons easily, and may be the expression of the vital force.

persons.name: Marcelo Arthur Mendes Waechter
persons.key_contribution: Scalar energy generator patent (WO2013155580A1) - household apparatus generating 12 Hz floating wave for health benefits
persons.notes: Brazilian inventor of scalar energy generation apparatus. Patent filed 2013, status Ceased.

persons.name: Gabriel Chardin
persons.title: CNRS Silver Medal (2007)
persons.key_contribution: Dirac-Milne cosmological model — universe with equal matter/antimatter, negative gravitational mass for antimatter, eliminating need for dark matter and dark energy
persons.notes: President of the Committee of Very Large Research Infrastructures at CNRS. Author of 'L'Insoutenable gravité de l'Univers' (Le Pommier, 2018). Cern experiments (Gbar, Alpha-g, AEgIS) designed to test his model.

persons.name: Prometheus S.p.A.
persons.affiliation: Kilometro Rosso Innovation District, Bergamo; Milan offices
persons.key_contribution: Development of LENR (Low Energy Nuclear Reactions) reactor technology for zero-emission energy production using water and electricity
persons.notes: Backed by Ground Control Holding. Collaborates with Politecnico di Milano and Università Milano-Bicocca. 1800+ hours of lab testing with positive energy balance (Q>1). Targeting TRL 6.

persons.name: Dr. Valerie Hunt
persons.key_contribution: Research on scalar energy in humans; human performance capacity when accessing scalar energy fields
persons.notes: Cited in patent WO2013155580A1 for discoveries about human performance and scalar energy fields. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Ondulavi (Brice)
persons.key_contribution: Accessible French-language explanations of scalar energy, scalar waves, and their health applications
persons.notes: Author at ondulavi.com. Covers scalar wave theory, vortex physics, and EMF health implications. References Meyl, Tesla, Maxwell.

persons.name: SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group
persons.key_contribution: Compendium of Vortex Physics — systematic compilation of vortex and ether concepts across 150 years of outsider research
persons.notes: Members: Rudolf Fehlmann, Elisabeth Lehmann, André Waser, Dr. Jakob Huber, Ben Jansen, Dr. Hanspeter Seiler, Dr. Hans Weber. Published May 1999. Complete translation available.

persons.name: Manfred Curry
persons.key_contribution: Curry network — diagonal global grid of telluric radiations crossing Hartmann network at 45°
persons.notes: Discovered diagonal grid complementary to Hartmann. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Dr. Peyré
persons.key_contribution: Peyré network — east-west oriented global grid with chakra correspondence, particularly heart chakra
persons.notes: French cosmotellurism researcher. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Gilbert Altenbach
persons.key_contribution: Popularized discovery circuits of cosmo-telluric high places in France, including Brocéliande
persons.notes: Co-author of 'Lieux magiques et sacrés de la France' (1987). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Boune Legrais
persons.key_contribution: Co-author of discovery circuits for French sacred and magical places
persons.notes: Co-author with Altenbach. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Adolphe Landspurg
persons.key_contribution: Detailed energetic circuits of Brocéliande with vibratory measurements using Bovis scale and geodynamiter
persons.notes: Co-author of 'Bretagne magique et vibratoire' (1999). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Norbert L'Hostis
persons.key_contribution: Co-author of detailed Brocéliande energetic circuits
persons.notes: Co-author with Landspurg. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Écoute Énergétique
persons.key_contribution: Practical geobiological site analysis and energetic circuit design in Brocéliande
persons.notes: Practitioner documenting detailed site harmonization protocols with measurements.

persons.name: Centre Ganesha / ChamanKa
persons.key_contribution: Educational articles on form waves, radiesthesia, and geobiology for French-speaking audience
persons.notes: Published comprehensive article on form waves (March 2026).

persons.name: Thomas Valone (Vassilatos)
persons.key_contribution: Author of 'Secrets of Cold War Technology' and 'Lost Science — Vassilatos's compilations of Tesla's radiant energy experiments
persons.notes: Vassilatos's statements about Tesla's experiments are referenced extensively in Lindemann's patent analysis. No primary works in collection yet.

persons.name: Sir William Crookes
persons.key_contribution: Invented the radiometer; studied radiant matter from incandescent bodies — foundational to Tesla's radiant energy concept
persons.notes: Tesla's friendship and admiration for Crookes led to the term 'radiant energy'. Crookes's radiometer showed that emissions from heated matter carry physical force.

persons.name: Salvatore Majorana
persons.key_contribution: LENR reactor research referenced in Corriere della Sera coverage of Prometheus reactor
persons.notes: Mentioned in press coverage of the Prometheus LENR reactor as 'the gentle reactor'. Not to be confused with physicist Ettore Majorana.

persons.name: Dmitri Mendeleev
persons.title: Creator of the Periodic Table
persons.key_contribution: Predicted two inert elements lighter than hydrogen; the lightest would be a gas penetrating everything — Tesla believed he had discovered this gas as the cause of the electrostatic field
persons.notes: Cited by Lindemann in the Tesla radiant energy analysis. Mendeleev's 1902 prediction of sub-hydrogen elements connects to Tesla's neutral particle theory.

persons.name: Rosella Denicolò
persons.key_contribution: Interviewed Emilio Del Giudice on Gerald Pollack's fourth phase of water discovery for A.CS.I.
persons.notes: Attributed as the interviewer in the Del Giudice/Pollack article from A.CS.I. CranioSacrale Italia.

persons.name: densifying through material manifestations
persons.notes: Added during db refresh 2026-09-01 from 2026-08-29-ether-einstein-constante-cosmologique-fr-en.md

persons.name: N.V. Filatov
persons.key_contribution: Discovered violation of conservation of momentum in gyroscope collisions (1960s)
persons.notes: Associate professor of theoretical mechanics. Found anomalous momentum changes when gyroscopes precess after elastic impact.

persons.name: V.N. Tolchin
persons.key_contribution: Invented the 4D gyroscope ('inertoid') — changes momentum using only internal inertial forces
persons.notes: Author of 'Inertoid, Inertial Forces as a Source of Motion' (1977). Chief designer at Perm Machine-Building Plant.

persons.name: Eric Laithwaite
persons.key_contribution: Gyroscopic system experiments showing anomalous weight changes in precessing gyroscopes
persons.notes: Professor of engineering. Known for linear motor invention and controversial gyroscopy research.

persons.name: Miguel Alcubierre
persons.key_contribution: Proposed warp drive metric within general relativity (1994) — torsion engine concept
persons.notes: Theoretical physicist. Alcubierre drive is a solution of Einstein's field equations allowing apparent faster-than-light travel.

persons.name: Paul Bauman
persons.key_contribution: Created first widely known vacuum energy generator (Testatika)
persons.notes: Swiss inventor, not a scientist by training. Created the Testatika device at Methernitha community.

persons.name: Eric Dollard
persons.key_contribution: Reproduced Tesla's one-wire transmission system (1988); demonstrated longitudinal electric waves
persons.notes: Co-founder of BSRF. Experiments with vacuum triodes and hydrogen spark gaps confirmed Tesla's radiant energy concepts.

persons.name: Edwin V. Gray
persons.key_contribution: Demonstrated 'cold electricity' motor powered by radiant electrostatic bursts from capacitor discharge
persons.notes: Inventor of the EMA motor (1970s). His 'splitting the positive' process was linked to Tesla's radiant energy by Lindemann.

persons.name: Michaud
persons.key_contribution: Model of confined electromagnetic fields in elementary particles — bridge to TUO vacuum tension
persons.notes: Proposed that vacuum tension derives from internal EM energy of particles. Referenced in TUO theory by François Maillot.

persons.name: Rudolf Fehlmann
persons.key_contribution: Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group; co-author of Compendium of Vortex Physics
persons.notes: Represented SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group in compendium publication.

persons.name: Elisabeth Lehmann
persons.key_contribution: Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group; co-author of Compendium of Vortex Physics
persons.notes: Represented SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group in compendium publication.

persons.name: Vladimir Dzhanibekov
persons.key_contribution: Discovered anomalous gyroscope axis rotation in weightlessness (1985) — quantum-like direction changes
persons.notes: Soviet cosmonaut. Discovery was hidden for 10 years. Effect shows gyroscope axis periodically changes direction at equal intervals in free fall.

persons.name: Plato
persons.key_contribution: Timaeus dialogue — Platonic solids as structure of elements; geometry as key to physical reality
persons.notes: Foundational figure for geometric physics tradition. Timaeus proposes that the four elements correspond to four Platonic solids.

persons.name: Johannes Kepler
persons.key_contribution: Mysterium Cosmographicum — attempt to relate planetary distances to Platonic solids; first mathematical cosmology
persons.notes: Kepler's vision of geometric cosmology directly inspires Spyridis' Platonic Theory of Everything.

persons.name: Albert Einstein
persons.key_contribution: General Relativity — spacetime geometry as source of gravitation; geometric foundation for modern physics
persons.notes: Shipov extends Einstein-Cartan geometry; Maillot bridges Einstein with TUO; Benaros references Einstein's cosmological constant.

persons.name: James Clerk Maxwell
persons.key_contribution: Maxwell's equations — unified electricity, magnetism, and light; foundation for electromagnetic theory
persons.notes: Meyl extends Maxwell to include scalar waves; Maillot bridges Maxwell with TUO; Magnitsky derives Maxwell-Lorentz from ether equations.

persons.name: Mario Contino
persons.key_contribution: Articles on form waves, sacred geometry, and subtle energies for Italian audience; links form waves to Sheldrake's morphic fields
persons.notes: Author at Blog del Mistero. Bridges Italian esoteric tradition with French radiesthesia and British biology of form.

persons.name: A.L. Dmitriev
persons.key_contribution: Leading geophysicist of Siberia; showed that open-pit mining causes geophysical imbalance in the Earth-Sun system, producing plasmodia on Earth's surface
persons.notes: Cited in Study on Torsion Fields (German source) regarding environmental consequences of resource extraction.

persons.name: Prof. Dr. N. Grachev
persons.affiliation: State Institute for Electronics and Mathematics, Moscow
persons.key_contribution: Comprehensive overview of torsion field theory, technology applications, and environmental implications; German translation source
persons.notes: Attributed author of the German study on torsion fields. Provides systematic overview of Russian torsion physics for Western audience.

persons.name: Louis de Broglie
persons.key_contribution: Pilot wave theory — quantum particles accompanied by a field; Nobel Prize 1929 for wave-particle duality
persons.notes: Foundational to de Broglie-Bohm theory used in consciousness quantum field models. Cited in Manzalini's consciousness paper.

persons.name: David Bohm
persons.key_contribution: Revived de Broglie's pilot wave theory (1952); developed quantum potential and active information concepts; demonstrated non-locality
persons.notes: Central to Manzalini's consciousness model — quantum field of consciousness extends Bohm's quantum field to living matter.

persons.name: Antony Valentini
persons.key_contribution: Quantum non-equilibrium theory — quantum mechanics as special case of broader physics where systems are far from quantum equilibrium
persons.notes: Cited in Manzalini's paper arguing consciousness requires physics beyond quantum equilibrium.

persons.name: Hiroomi Umezawa
persons.key_contribution: Quantum field theory of brain — many-body model linking quantum fields to biological coherence and consciousness
persons.notes: Cited in Manzalini's paper for quantum field approaches to living matter and consciousness.

persons.name: Francis Fukuyama
persons.key_contribution: Author of 'The End of History' — argued civilization had reached its final form
persons.notes: Cited in Study on Torsion Fields as counterpoint — argued against technological stagnation as historical pattern shows new paradigms emerge.

persons.name: Thomas William Barrett
persons.key_contribution: Extended electromagnetic theory using SU(2) gauge theory; non-Abelian Maxwell equations; soliton solutions for vacuum energy
persons.notes: Published 'Extended Theory of Electromagnetism' (1993). Barrett's gauge-theoretic extension of Maxwell provides the mathematical foundation for Schadach's applications to ZPE and longitudinal waves.

persons.name: M. Jonathan Vega
persons.key_contribution: Structured scientific study on light propagation; reformulation of Einstein's equations as nonlinear Maxwell-type system
persons.notes: ORCID: 0009-0003-4053-7718. Cited by François Maillot in TUO classical formalism paper (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17311742). Zenodo deposit: 10.5281/zenodo.17307856.

persons.notes: Claimed to replicate Tesla's generator; from Odessa region

persons.name: Thomas Townsend Brown
persons.key_contribution: Discovered the Biefeld-Brown effect (electrogravitics) at age 15 in 1920; high-voltage capacitor thrust
persons.notes: Observed movement of Coolidge X-ray tube under high voltage; called effect electrogravitational

persons.name: David Hudson

persons.name: David Hutchison
persons.key_contribution: Hutchison effect — anomalous weight loss in objects under electromagnetic fields
persons.notes: Known for the Hutchison effect

persons.name: G. Nikolaev
persons.key_contribution: Detected scalar magnetic field force in experiments with variable charge density
persons.notes: Author of "The Scalar Magnetic Field" (Tomsk, 1997)

persons.name: Abraham Pais
persons.key_contribution: Noted the problem of origin of inertial fields as most obscure question in particle theory
persons.notes: American theoretical physicist; quoted by Shipov regarding inertial fields

persons.name: M. Lobova
persons.key_contribution: Experiment showing weight loss of precessing gyroscope (0.15 ± 0.01 g)
persons.notes: Gyroscope precession weight loss experiment

persons.name: Roger Penrose
persons.key_contribution: Spinor theory and spacetime geometry (with Rindler); Penrose-Hawking singularity theorems
persons.notes: Cited in Shipov torsion fields paper for spinor and spacetime geometry work

persons.name: Wilhelm Bauer
persons.key_contribution: Derived Lamb vector from potential; formulated conditions for thermal-to-kinetic energy conversion in vortices
persons.notes: Physics diploma thesis at age 59. Advanced vortex theory as outsider.

persons.name: Jakob Huber
persons.key_contribution: Founded Aetherics — vortex-theoretical approach to non-material physics based on coupled vector fields
persons.notes: Dr. El.Eng. Developed fundamental field equation for ether vortex dynamics.

persons.name: Hans Lugt
persons.key_contribution: Wrote 'Vortex Flows in Nature and Technology' and 'Introduction to Vortex Theory' — first compendium of conventional vortex physics
persons.notes: Concluded scientific career in 1996 with publication of vortex theory compendium.

persons.name: Konstantin Meyl
persons.key_contribution: Developed potential vortex theory through extension of Maxwell's equations
persons.notes: Prof. Dr. El.Eng. Holistic field-theory-based approach to vortex dynamics.

persons.name: Hanspeter Seiler
persons.key_contribution: Developed Kosmonen ether model based on vortices in 'The Kosmonen Space'
persons.notes: Dr. med. Based on Franz Anton Mesner's ether concepts.

persons.name: André Waser
persons.key_contribution: Synthesis of vortex concepts in 'The Puzzling Nature'; co-author of SAFE compendium
persons.notes: El.Eng. Provided comparative overall view of vortex physics.

persons.name: Arturo Ponce de León
key_works: Sacred Geometry: Geometric Qualities of Matter and Energy
The Power of Life in Sacred Geometry and Biological Architecture
persons.description: Researcher and author on sacred geometry (psicogeometría). Developed the Pentaflor process model describing energy-to-matter transition through phi spiral, pi sphere, and euler solidification. Collaborates with Ninón Fregoso.
persons.key_contribution: Psychogeometry — phi/pi/Euler as the geometric code for energy-to-matter conversion; Pentaflor process
persons.notes: Proposes 'Sustainable Geometry' as secular replacement for 'Sacred Geometry'.

persons.name: Emilio Del Giudice
key_works: Fröhlich-type coherent excitations in biological systems
persons.description: Italian physicist who extended quantum field theory to biological systems. Developed the theory of water coherence domains with Giuliano Preparata. Explained Pollack's exclusion zones through quantum field theory. Connected Szent-Györgyi's insight on water as electron donor to quantum coherence.
persons.key_contribution: Coherence domains of water; explanation of Pollack's exclusion zone via quantum field theory of water
persons.notes: Italian physicist who lectured on Gerald Pollack's fourth phase of water discovery, connecting it to biological morphologies and coherence domains.

persons.name: Albert Szent-Györgyi
key_works: What is Life? (1944 proposal on water and electrons)
persons.description: Nobel laureate who proposed in the 1950s that water is the source of electrons for the chemical reactions of life. His insight that it takes 12.6 eV to release an electron from isolated water but far less in biological contexts was confirmed by Pollack's exclusion zone research.
persons.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine (1937)
persons.key_contribution: Identified the central mystery of biological electron transfer — proposed water as the electron source for life's chemical reactions
persons.notes: Nobel laureate who highlighted in the 1950s that living matter requires an electron donor, and intuited that water itself was the source. His question drove Pollack's and Del Giudice's research.

persons.name: Herbert Fröhlich
persons.description: Pioneered the concept that quantum coherence is an intrinsic property of living cells. His work on Fröhlich-type coherent excitations was carried forward by Del Giudice, Preparata, and others in quantum biophysics.

persons.name: Ilya Prigogine
persons.description: Nobel laureate who developed the theory of dissipative structures — open systems far from thermodynamic equilibrium that maintain local order. His framework provides the thermodynamic basis for understanding implosion as a negentropic process.

persons.name: Basil Hiley
key_works: Active information and the quantum potential
persons.description: Collaborator with David Bohm on the de Broglie-Bohm pilot wave theory. Reinterpreted Eccles' proposal on a mental field in light of quantum potential and active information. Key figure in understanding quantum potential as active information.

persons.name: Ninón Fregoso
key_works: The Power of Life in Sacred Geometry and Biological Architecture (with Ponce de León)
persons.description: Collaborator with Arturo Ponce de León on psicogeometría. Co-author of 'The Power of Life in Sacred Geometry and Biological Architecture'.

persons.name: Christopher Seebach
persons.key_contribution: Contemporary vortex research applications (Appendix I of Acqua Viva)
persons.notes: Contributed appendix on contemporary vortex applications to Acqua Viva (Schauberger) Italian edition.

persons.name: Peter Hewitt
persons.key_contribution: Physics and the Vortex appendix (Appendix II of Acqua Viva)
persons.notes: Contributed appendix on physics and the vortex to Acqua Viva (Schauberger) Italian edition.

persons.name: Kai Curry-Lindahl
persons.key_contribution: Preface to Acqua Viva (Schauberger) Italian edition
persons.notes: Swedish zoologist and conservationist who wrote the preface to the Italian edition of Acqua Viva.

persons.name: Juan Miguel Rivero y Hornos Tverjanovich
persons.key_contribution: Vortex Motor concept — negentropic propulsion via ether implosion dynamics, extending Schauberger's work
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17626722), November 2025

persons.name: SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group (Rudolf Fehlmann, Elisabeth Lehmann, André Waser, Dr. Jakob Huber)
persons.affiliation: SAFE — Swiss Association for Free Energy
persons.key_contribution: Compendium of Vortex Physics — systematic compilation of Schauberger's vortex physics theories, water dynamics, temperature gradients
persons.notes: Published 1999. Source domain safeswiss.org has expired; content preserved from original document.

persons.name: Edouard (Vibratis)
persons.key_contribution: Radionics and radiesthesia education — form waves, distance action, Chaumery-Belizal tradition, Servranx brothers
persons.notes: Published on Vibratis.fr, January 2020

persons.name: Félix and William Servranx
persons.key_contribution: Radionics and distance action theory; operator-witness-instrument model; distinction between radiesthesia (distance perception) and radionics (distance action)
persons.notes: Authors of 'Radionique et action à distance. Cours pratique' (Editions Servranx, 1995). Belgian brothers who systematized radionics theory.

persons.name: Albert Abrams
persons.key_contribution: Developed radionics in the United States using electromagnetic machines for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes; published research in 1916
persons.notes: Early 20th century physician who pioneered apparatus-based radionics. His machines were attacked by the medical establishment.

persons.name: Raphaël Dajafée
persons.key_contribution: Documented the possible German origins of radionics; authored a book on radionics
persons.notes: Interviewed about radionics history. Recounted story of German health practitioner who discovered distance healing with geometric shapes.

persons.name: Ernst Lecher
persons.key_contribution: Demonstrated speed of electromagnetic waves using parallel Lecher wires (1890)
persons.notes: Historical figure. Lecher antenna named in his honor by Reinhard Schneider.

persons.name: Reinhard Schneider
persons.key_contribution: Invented the Lecher antenna for geobiological detection
persons.notes: Named the Lecher antenna in homage to Ernst Lecher. The antenna operates on the principle of Lecher wires.

persons.name: Walter Kunnen
persons.key_contribution: Improved the Lecher antenna and made it useful for physicians
persons.notes: Professor who refined the Lecher antenna for medical and geobiological applications.

persons.name: Patrick Darcheville
persons.key_contribution: Lecturer and geobiologist; author of Radiesthesia from Antiquity to the Present Day, The Flora of Cathedrals, Druids or Monks?, The Numbers of the Apocalypse. Wrote preface to the 2013 Dervy re-edition of Chaumery & de Belizal's Essai de radiesthésie vibratoire.

persons.name: Howard Carter
persons.key_contribution: Discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922. Owned a sandstone ring from Aswan (Ring of Re / Atlantean Ring) said to have protected him from the curse. The ring passed to his grandson André de Bélizal, who studied its form-wave properties with Léon Chaumery.

persons.name: Felix Bloch
persons.key_contribution: Nobel Prize in Physics (1952). The Bloch equation describes the change of spin under the action of an electromagnetic field — foundational to torsion field generator theory and NMR.

persons.name: Anna Maël
persons.key_contribution: Author of Le Pendule du 5e Règne (The Pendulum of the Fifth Kingdom) and The Magician of the Fifth Kingdom. Inspired by the geobiological work of Bernard Coulombez. Lectures on themes of the Fifth Kingdom.

persons.name: Bernard-Georges Condé
persons.key_contribution: Developed radionics as distance action using form waves; pioneered subtle art of radionic practice
persons.notes: Mentioned as a pioneer of radionics in the French radiesthesia tradition. Developed the practice enabling operators to influence energetic fields at a distance.

persons.name: Bernard Coulombez
persons.key_contribution: Spiritual and energetic work inspiring the Fifth Kingdom research
persons.notes: Geobiologist whose work inspired Anna Maël's 'Le Pendule du 5e Règne'.

persons.name: Dr Olivier Madelrieux
persons.key_contribution: Author and educator on radiesthesia, radionics, and form waves at devenir-magnetiseur.com
persons.notes: Runs devenir-magnetiseur.com, a French educational site on magnetism, radiesthesia, and energy healing. Offers video training on pendulum use and form waves.

persons.name: Sergueïev
persons.key_contribution: Soviet parapsychologist who studied emissions of energy due to forms
persons.notes: Cited in Chaumery & de Bélizal's 'Essai de radiesthésie vibratoire' for his work on form energy emissions. Quoted as saying that with better understanding of form energy emissions, we would go further than with electricity and nuclear power.

persons.name: Georges Lakhovsky
persons.key_contribution: Cellular oscillation theory; proposed cells communicate via electromagnetic radiation; invented Multiple Wave Oscillator for cancer therapy
persons.notes: Russian-born engineer who became French in 1909. His theories preceded form wave theory and influenced later radiesthesia research.

persons.name: André Bovis
persons.key_contribution: Invented the Bovis scale (Bovis biometer) in the 1930s — measures energetic vitality in Bovis Units (UB); calibrated with engineer André Simoneton using sun's red spectrum as reference
persons.notes: Self-taught inventor from Nice (coppersmith/hardware merchant), not a physician or Egyptologist as often mythologized. Created incubator for poultry, hygrometer, and ovimeter for testing egg freshness. Grandson Jacques Bovis is a major figure in modern geobiology.

persons.name: André Simoneton
persons.key_contribution: Co-developer with André Bovis of the Bovis biometer calibration using the red spectrum of sunlight as physical reference
persons.notes: Engineer who helped transform Bovis's initial scale idea into an operational tool based on physical wavelength reference.

persons.name: Maude
persons.key_contribution: GaiaMamart.com — contemporary French form waves and radiesthesia education
persons.notes: Published on GaiaMamart, February 17, 2024. Contemporary French practitioner.

persons.name: Franz Pöpel
persons.key_contribution: Co-conducted the 1952 Stuttgart pipe-friction experiments with Viktor Schauberger: spiral kudu-horn-shaped pipes showed friction decreasing with velocity, reaching negative resistance
persons.notes: Referenced in Hasslberger's Schauberger/Herbrand analysis and Alexandersson's 'Living Water'

persons.name: Rudolf Steiner
persons.role: philosopher, founder of anthroposophy, editor of Goethe's scientific works
persons.key_contribution: Compiled and introduced Goethe's scientific writings (Fratelli Melita, 1988 edition of 'Goethe's Scientific Works'); founder of anthroposophy, whose epistemology of 'exact thinking' and morphogenetic views intersect the archive's Goetheanism and subtle-energy material
persons.notes: Referenced as author of the work commented in Lucio Russo's course (ospi.it transcription)

persons.name: Lucio Russo
persons.key_contribution: Held a 52-meeting course (Sep 2000–Nov 2001) on Rudolf Steiner's 'Goethe's Scientific Works', transcribed by Roberto Marcelli and published by ospi.it
persons.notes: Name matches the Italian historian of science (b. 1944); the ospi.it course context is anthroposophical, so identity should be treated as probable rather than certain

persons.name: Denis Machon
persons.key_contribution: Methodological critique of Yves Rocard's dowser experiments (1957-1960), demonstrating how post-hoc data massage and non-blind protocols produced false positives from chance-level results
persons.notes: Professor at INSA Lyon – Université de Lyon; published in The Conversation France (Aug 2026)

persons.name: Abbé Alexis Mermet
persons.key_contribution: Coined the term 'radiesthésie' (1930); invented map dowsing; authored 'Comment j'opère' (1935) — the foundational text of modern French radiesthesia
persons.notes: Vatican consulted him to locate a missing missionary in Africa; his methods influenced Dr. Oscar Brunler and the entire French-speaking radiesthesia tradition

persons.name: Barthélemy Bléton
persons.key_contribution: Illiterate peasant from Dauphiné whose demonstrations before the Académie des sciences (1778) marked the transition of dowsing from peasant superstition to scientific investigation
persons.notes: Discovered seven unknown springs in the park of the Château de La Muette; became official consultant for well placement in several French cities

persons.name: Dr. Pierre Thouvenel
persons.key_contribution: Published 'Mémoire sur la faculté hydroscopique' (1778) documenting Bléton's demonstrations, marking the first scientific treatment of dowsing
persons.notes: King's physician; his memoir marked a turning point in the scientific study of dowsing

persons.name: P. A. Morel
persons.key_contribution: Co-author with A. de Belizal of 'Physique Micro-Vibratoire et Forces Invisibles' (Desforges, Paris, 1976); co-developer of micro-vibratory physics and the Chaumery–de Belizal form-wave school
persons.notes: Longtime collaborator of de Belizal; the 1976 volume systematizes the school's vibratory radiesthesia (ondes de forme, negative green V-, spectral emissions of shapes).

persons.name: Davis and Rawis
persons.notes: Research on Bloch Wall in magnets where scalar energy is captured. Referenced in Brazilian scalar energy generator patent WO2013155580A1.

persons.name: Cesar Sóos
persons.notes: Brazilian researcher developing technological and therapeutic applications with scalar energy. Referenced in WO2013155580A1.

persons.name: Roberto Frascari
persons.notes: Brazilian researcher developing technological and therapeutic applications with scalar energy. Referenced in WO2013155580A1.

persons.name: Jean Markale
persons.notes: French author (1928-2008) with national audience. Author of Guide spirituel de la forêt de Brocéliande (1996). Popularized geobiology and cosmotellurism in Brocéliande forest context.

persons.name: Wilhelm Reich
persons.key_contribution: Discovered orgone energy; developed orgone accumulator; pioneered bio-energetic approaches to psychology and physics
persons.notes: Student of Freud; broke with psychoanalysis to develop orgonomy; persecuted by FDA; died in prison. Author of 'The Function of the Orgasm' and 'Ether, God and Devil'

persons.name: Peter Nasselstein
persons.key_contribution: Wrote 'Oranur-Physik' — comprehensive introduction to Wilhelm Reich's orgone biophysics, bridging Reich's discoveries with modern ether physics
persons.notes: Copyright 2025; published via orgonomie.net; comprehensive synthesis of Reich's physics contributions

persons.name: David Boadella
persons.key_contribution: 1955 lecture 'Orgone Energy, Love and Spaceships': connected orgone spiral dynamics, Reich's gravitation theory (superimposed orgone currents), cloudbuster weather engineering, and Leonard Cramp's aether-gravitation theory
persons.notes: Contrasted Cramp's 'insubstantial aether' with Reich's 'demonstrable orgone energy'

persons.name: Leonard G. Cramp
persons.key_contribution: Aether-based theory of gravitation and flying-saucer propulsion (Spacecraft in the Making, 1954); cited by Boadella as more worked-out than Reich's own gravitation theory
persons.notes: Missing node of the pushing-gravity convergence — original works not yet in collection; flagged as acquisition target

persons.name: Dr. Ibrahim Karim
persons.key_contribution: Developed BioGeometry from Ancient Egyptian temple science and the radiesthesia tradition; defined BG3 (Higher Harmonic of Ultra-Violet, Higher Harmonic of Gold, Negative Green as carrier) as the harmonizing energy quality at shape-centers; applied it to EMF harmonization (Swiss town projects), agriculture, and health research
persons.notes: BioGeometry's Negative Green component is explicitly 'from radiesthesia' — the direct downstream heir of the Chaumery-de Belizal V-. Key works: BioGeometry Signatures; Physics of Quality measurement system using color/angle/string-length calibrated pendulums.

persons.name: Karel Drbal
persons.key_contribution: Czechoslovak patent 91304 (1959) 'Method for maintaining razor blades' — the pyramid-shape preservation patent; independent arrival at the form-emits-preserving-ray claim structure parallel to the French V- mummification claims
persons.notes: Named in Davidson's Russian torsion genealogy alongside Pavlita, Belizal, Turenne. Patent text not yet in archive — flagged as an upgrade target.

persons.name: Jean de La Foye
persons.key_contribution: Popularized the form-wave school for the geobiology generation; author of 'Ondes de vie, ondes de mort' (1975); linked form waves to Sheldrake's morphogenetic field theory
persons.notes: Bridge figure between the Chaumery-de Belizal school and modern French geobiology.

persons.name: Agnès Burnet
persons.key_contribution: Documents the Chaumery-Bélizal 2x12 color spectrum for the modern geobiology audience: 12 colors in magnetic phase (pro-biotic) vs 12 in electric phase (anti-biotic), with V- first in the magnetic list
persons.notes: Representative of the geobiology generation: V- becomes a diagnostic quality of places, not an engineering ray.

persons.name: Armand Viré
persons.key_contribution: Scientist-president of the AAR (Association des Amis de la Radiesthésie); legitimized dowsing through scientific credentials; pioneered geological and agricultural radiesthesia applications
persons.notes: Composite biography from multiple French sources. Key figure in establishing radiesthesia as a legitimate scientific practice in France.

persons.name: Dominique Massonnaud
persons.key_contribution: Historical analysis of Goethe's relationship with French transformism and evolutionary thought
persons.notes: Author of 'Goethe et le transformisme français: histoire et actualité' (HAL-02560509)

persons.name: Vicomte Henry de France
persons.key_contribution: Second president of the AAR after Abbé Bouly; founder of Chronique des Sourciers (1930); author of Le Sourcier moderne; pioneer of agricultural radiesthesia and two-origin theory (intuition on maps, physical effect in the field)
persons.notes: Known as 'the Aristocrat of Radiesthesia'. Composite biography from four French sources.

persons.name: Gabriel Lesourd
persons.key_contribution: Pendular urine diagnosis; Tisanes Lesourd; black-glass pendulum; publisher of La Science nouvelle journal
persons.notes: Prominent pharmacist-radiesthésiste of the 1930s. Subject of Thierry Lefebvre's historical study.

persons.name: Thierry Lefebvre
persons.key_contribution: Historical documentation of pharmacist-radiesthésistes in 1930s France, especially Gabriel Lesourd and the medical section of the AAR
persons.notes: Published in Revue d'Histoire de la Pharmacie, vol. 92, no. 344, 2004

persons.name: Hannes Alfvén
persons.title: Nobel laureate (Physics 1970)
persons.key_contribution: Plasma cosmology — Alfvén-Klein model; galaxy formation via Birkeland currents; critical of Big Bang cosmology
persons.notes: Proposed laboratory scaling results could be extrapolated to Universe scale. Alternative to mainstream astrophysics.
